notes: Fixes the daily loss limit never resetting: once equity sat 5% below the level at start-up the bot stopped taking entries permanently until it was restarted, while still appearing to run normally. The limit now rolls over at the UTC day boundary as intended. Also fixes the economic-calendar feed retrying on every scan after a failure, which triggered rate-limiting and produced a misleading 'check internet connection' message; failed fetches now back off and the log reports the real reason.
